visual_mood: Professional, timeless, tactile, like a high-end literary magazine. Emphasis on negative space, striking typography, and structural lines.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-7xl font-light tracking-tighter leading-[1.1] text-stone-900 font-['Cormorant_Garamond']
rules.h2: text-4xl md:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight text-stone-900 font-['Cormorant_Garamond']
rules.h3: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-stone-800 font-['Cormorant_Garamond']
rules.body: text-lg md:text-xl font-light leading-relaxed text-stone-700 font-['Newsreader']
rules.overline: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#800020] font-['Newsreader']

layout.spacing_system: Generous. Use p-12, p-24, gap-12, gap-24. Allow content to breathe like a printed page.
layout.grid_mode: Editorial Asymmetry. Avoid perfectly balanced columns. Mix col-span-4 with col-span-8 in a 12-column grid.
layout.borders: Use 1px solid #E7E5E4 (stone-200) borders to separate sections horizontally, mimicking newspaper/editorial dividing lines.

navigation.style: Solid Minimalist. Sticky top. bg-[#FDFBF7] with subtle border-b border-stone-200.
navigation.links: Hover effects change text to Burgundy. Minimalist, text-sm uppercase tracking-widest for links.

hero_section.layout: Grid split: Left side huge typography ('Cristiano Penido', 'Escritor & Romancista' and Bio), Right side elegant placeholder for author photo.
hero_section.author_placeholder: aspect-[3/4] bg-[#F4F1EA] border border-stone-300 flex items-center justify-center p-8 text-stone-500 font-['Cormorant_Garamond'] italic text-2xl shadow-[inset_0_0_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02)]

book_placeholder_card.structure: aspect-[2/3] relative group overflow-hidden bg-[#F4F1EA] border border-stone-200 shadow-[inset_0_0_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)] flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-8 text-center transition-all duration-500 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-xl hover:border-[#800020]/30
book_placeholder_card.typography: Title in Cormorant Garamond, subtle subtitle. Deep burgundy color for the title to simulate foil stamping.
book_placeholder_card.no_image_rule: Strictly NO dummy images. Use pure CSS/Tailwind typography for the cover.

contact_section.email_display: Huge text (text-4xl md:text-6xl) in Cormorant Garamond text-stone-900.
contact_section.copy_button: Subtle outline button or text link with icon. On hover, text turns burgundy.

animations.scroll_reveal: Fade in and slight upward translation (translate-y-4 to 0) on scroll using framer-motion.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, copy email button) MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='nav-home-link', data-testid='copy-email-button', data-testid='book-card-amazon-link'.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a JavaScript (.js) React project using Tailwind CSS. Do not use TypeScript.
Embed Google Fonts directly in src/index.css using the provided @import rules.
Configure Tailwind (tailwind.config.js) to extend colors with the provided hex codes and add 'Cormorant_Garamond' and 'Newsreader' to the font family.
Do not use generic Shadcn card components if they look too tech-focused. Build custom HTML/Tailwind editorial components using the layout rules.

For the book covers and author photo, strictly use HTML/CSS placeholders as defined in book_placeholder_card. Do NOT use unsplash or dummyimage URLs. The user explicitly requested elegant beige/ivory placeholders with serif typography.
Implement the layout with high asymmetry and prominent typographic scale. Let the words act as the primary visual art.
Ensure all text/copy is in Portuguese (Brazilian).
Use lucide-react for minimal icons (e.g., Copy icon for the email).
